title: Trading Bot
author: JakeDelabare
selftext: I made a trading bro that this past month has made 35%+ revenue from starting capitol over the past month, but I don’t have the money to make use of it with the starting capitol it’s coded for. I am new to Reddit and don’t believe this is against the guidelines, if it is please take down the post and DM me why it was removed.
